conventions.S: the certificate's folder: results/B58_IDENTITY/certificate_tools.tar.gz unpacked anywhere (tar -xzf ... -C <folder>), or the scratch folder this run used (scratchpad build1b/fixes). Every tool finds S from its own location, S/tools
conventions.PY: C:/Users/badcl/Desktop/GRAD-project/.venv/Scripts/python.exe (Python 3.13.2), for every command in both trees; the shell tools read $PY and $CAND from the environment when set
conventions.REPO: C:/Users/badcl/Desktop/GRAD-project, the candidate: GRA-test's working tree with build step 1 and the review's fixes
conventions.REF: $S/ref: git archive cf43fbb, extracted (git archive --format=tar cf43fbb | tar -x -C $S/ref); the first certificate's reference evidence is in the archive under out/ref, L4/ref_*, L5/ref_*, L6 (the npz dumps are not archived: re-run them), L7/ref_*, app/ref*, lab (compare files only)
